g.text: Source: Core theme/tokens.ts / Brand color identifies the product; status colors keep their own roles.
Three stems + two spaces = 5 equal modules
Roof, vertical stems and vertical spaces: 15.2 units
Minimum clear space: one module (20% of symbol height)
Standard lockup gap: 0.5H / wordmark cap height: H
Line outline: same contour, 2-unit stroke, minimum 64px canvas
Wordmark: Helvetica Neue Regular, converted to vector paths
Small UI: filled, no additional Tab target
No stretching, gradients, shadows or doubled strokes
